subject: lk-imp
title: LK.IMP.------C.CONT.
description: Chart 2 of 3 on book p. 47 (WM-23). LK-IMP (linkage implications) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; C-CONT (composite continuance) is the partner. The straight main line from the subject to C-CONT has a junction labeled WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle). From the subject: WO-EXP-PRI. From WO-EXP-PRI: the partner C-CONT and PRI-INFO (principle information). From PRI-INFO: TH-CONT (thrust continuance), ACC-DY (accelerated dynamics) and MT-INFO (multi-information). From TH-CONT: DYM-F (dynamic functionalism). From DYM-F: PR-TRS. From PR-TRS: SOC-RT (social reality). From MT-INFO: VT-DY (vibrational dynamics). From VT-DY: AF-DY (affinity dynamics).
